profile.headline: Software Developer/Analyst at American Share Insurance
profile.summary: I am currently a Software Developer/Analyst at American Share Insurance. I went to Ohio University and studied business analytics and MIS.

positions.title: Software Developer/Analyst
positions.description: I am a Software Developer/Analyst for American Share Insurance. I create and enhance asp.net web pages using vb.net and SQL on the back-end. I also do IT work around the office.

positions.title: Data Collector
positions.description: I am a data collector for PFF. I collect and chart detailed play-by-play data for NCAA games.

positions.title: Data Journalist
positions.description: I worked as a freelance data journalist for Sports Data entering live data and events during matches

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: I worked as a teacher's assistant in the Ohio University College of Business AIS department for prescriptive analytics.

positions.title: Product Cost Analysis Intern
positions.description: I worked as a product cost analysis intern at Pine Hill Golf Course over the summer. I helped the golf course order beverages, create the tee sheets, and create and organize outing contracts.

positions.title: Delivery Driver
positions.description: I worked part-time for DoorDash picking up and delivering food to customers.

positions.title: Starter
positions.description: I worked as a starter at Pine Hill Golf Club parking carts, answering the phone, talking with customers, and working as a cashier to improve the customer's experience.

positions.title: Member
positions.description: One-year program designed to allow students to reach their potential as leaders.
